slides.title: Federal government named a six-month administration
slides.body: PM Abiy Ahmed's office announced it on October 16, citing services, rebuilding, returns and elections.

slides.title: TPLF calls it illegitimate
slides.body: Anadolu reported the TPLF said decisions under the team have "no legality or enforceability."

slides.title: Airport warning, disputed
slides.body: The TPLF alleged troop use of Mekelle's airport and urged no movement there. No evidence was provided; this is not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Keep travel and aid open.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Anadolu Agency, "Ethiopia's TPLF rejects new Tigray administration as illegitimate" · Oct 17, 2026; Kulu Media · Oct 17, 2026

card.title: TPLF rejects caretaker team
card.body: Anadolu reported the TPLF called it illegitimate.
